title: Open vowels: /ʌ/ and /ɑ/
goal: Practise /ʌ/ and /ɑ/ and use it in a short, understandable exchange.
cue: For /ɑ/, open the jaw and let the tongue sit low. For /ʌ/, use a more central vowel. Both can be short or long depending on the surrounding sounds.
spelling: The u in cup and o in cop are different here. American vowel patterns vary by region.
task: Request one cup. Use the word in a full short sentence.
story: A cup is on a box. The cup is hot.
reviewPrompt: Return to day 6, 13, 17, 19. Recall a word or say one useful phrase before opening those lessons.
